title: BEACON trend-projection labelling parameters (ESCALATION / IMPACT_OVER_TIME)
description: Validates config/trend-projection.json — the uncertainty curves and horizon checkpoints the two trend-derived prediction kinds are labelled with (ADR-033 §4.1/§4.2, FEV-7). Projection parameters are DATA, never literals in a use-case (ADR-012). Every block MUST declare its own `basis` prose, so a number cannot be added or changed here without stating what grounds it. Uncertainty values are LABELS on a first-order projection; they are not probabilities of occurrence (finding F-34). This schema is deliberately NOT an extension of schemas/threshold-rule.schema.json, which is dead and drifted from its domain type (finding F-33) — it is a live schema, pinned to the shipped config by trend-projection-config.test.ts.

escalation.description: The ESCALATION uncertainty curve: a floor for a well-sampled slope, plus a penalty per sample short of the reference count. Fewer samples ⇒ higher uncertainty (ADR-033 §4.1).

impactOverTime.description: The IMPACT_OVER_TIME horizon checkpoints and its horizon-compounding uncertainty curve (ADR-033 §4.2). checkpointHours must be non-empty, positive and strictly ascending — the ascent is enforced by the parser, which a JSON-Schema cannot state.
